transformations.description: Getting any 'failed' jobs from the task logs table for the passed in JOB ID - we'll do a max on the JOB_LOG_ID and then join it to the vw_job_Log_Satus pipeline (if it joins we have a running Job with a failed task then we can set the JOB_LOG record to failed)
transformations.name: src_Task_Logs

transformations.description: We source from the view as this has the root parent ID. We can then set all 'running' jobs in this tree to 'Failed'
transformations.name: src_vw_Job_Log_Status

fields.name: o_Additional_Info
fields.expression: Additional_Info || IIF(ISNULL(Additional_Info),NULL,' <-> ')|| 'Failed run at ' || to_char(SYSDATE,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')

transformations.description: This is the 2nd pipeline in the flow and aborts the mapping which in turn aborts the taskflow - remember that this taskflow is executed when the max-retries is reached
transformations.name: src_Dummy

transformations.description: Filter is in place 'just in case' .ie. nothing gets written as we simply want to abort the flow in this pipeline
transformations.name: Filter
